description: Provisions and clones the OpenCode workbench onto Linux machines — locally or over SSH — reproducing the config, MCP servers (35), agent skills (45), plugins and Docker tooling. Exposes 10 tools over stdio, including a full install/update/remove lifecycle.
rules: Run locally with `npx -y @simonmak-ascent/opencode-workbench` (Node stdio MCP server; no API key).

Drive a clone with the tool order `describe_workbench` → `inspect_target` → `plan_clone` → `apply_clone` → `verify_clone`; use `install_component`/`remove_component`/`update_component` for per-component lifecycle.
`apply_clone` and `install_component` are consent-gated: without `confirm:true` they return a plan and change nothing.
Every tool takes a `target` of `{mode: "local"}` or `{mode: "ssh", host, user, port?, identityFile?}`.
The connector never reads, transmits or writes secret values; `apply_clone` writes an empty `~/.env.workbench` template (mode 600) listing the `{env:VAR}` names to fill in.
`apply_clone` is idempotent; pass `dryRun: true` to preview the plan without making changes.
